code:
Three nightly jobs, all at midnight:
  - SLA recalculation
  - Data archival
  - Reporting refresh

Symptom: morning dashboard data is
stale; SLA job sometimes unfinished.
caption: Nobody designed it this way on purpose.

code:
Wrong instinct:
  "The reporting job's script broke."

Real pattern:
  3 unrelated jobs, same start time,
  no recent code changes
  -> semaphore contention (Lesson 13)
caption: All three affected together points at contention, not a bug.

code:
Before:  00:00  00:00  00:00
          SLA  Archive Report

After:   00:00  00:20  00:40
          SLA  Archive Report

No script changes -- only WHEN
each job begins.
caption: Lesson 14's fix, applied directly.
